business_summary: Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. focuses on effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. was formerly known as RTNVM Acquisition Corp. and changed its name to Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. in August 2025. Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp.은 합병, 주식 교환, 자산 인수, 주식 매입, 구조 조정 또는 하나 이상의 기업과 유사한 사업 결합을 수행하는 데 중점을 두고 있습니다. Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp.은 이전에 RTNVM Acquisition Corp.로 알려졌으며 2025년 8월에 Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp.은 2025년에 법인화되었으며 뉴욕주 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
